data.name: ClearIt M4
data.detailed_description:
Test your aim and puzzle-solving skills across a huge variety of challenging levels! Shoot colorful balls from the edges of the playing field and match them with balls of the same color to clear the board.

But as you progress, the puzzles become more complex. Explosives, magnets, rockets, traps, moving obstacles, bombs, locks, barriers and other special elements will constantly change the way you approach each level. Use their unique properties to create chain reactions, open blocked paths and find the best way to clear the field.

Game Features

  • Colorful ball-matching gameplay — shoot balls from the sides of the field and destroy matching colors.

  • Dozens of unique mechanics and obstacles — each new element introduces a different challenge.

  • Strategic puzzles — carefully choose the direction and timing of every shot.

  • Powerful special elements — use explosions, rockets, magnets, bombs and other objects to clear large areas.

  • Moving and changing targets — some objects change their position or color, requiring quick thinking and precise shots.

  • Varied objectives — clear the entire field, activate special objects, collect items, form words and overcome unique challenges.

  • Competition mode — challenge the computer on identical levels. You and your opponent receive different sets of balls, and the first player to completely clear their field wins.

Every level is a new puzzle. Plan your shots, use the environment to your advantage and clear the field with as few moves as possible!
